# Memphis Style System

## Visual DNA

- Bright, playful, geometric, and intentionally layered
- 80s-90s Memphis energy with modern polish
- Bold color blocking and asymmetrical composition
- Sticker-like cards, framed sections, and decorative punctuation

## Palette

- Base: warm cream or paper white
- Accents: saturated coral, cobalt, teal, yellow, lime, and black
- Use one dominant accent per slide
- Keep contrast high and avoid muddy midtones

## Shapes

- Use dots, squiggles, zigzags, rings, triangles, grids, and halftone-like textures
- Mix rounded cards with sharp graphic elements
- Let decorations support the content instead of competing with it

## Typography

- Big title, medium subtitle, compact body
- Mix weight and scale for hierarchy
- Keep line lengths short
- Let typography feel playful but still disciplined

## Layout

- Offset blocks instead of centered symmetry every time
- Use overlap, rotation, and framed panels sparingly
- Create contrast between dense and open areas
- Leave breathing room around the main message

## Anti-Patterns

- Flat corporate white-on-white layouts
- Random neon clutter with no hierarchy
- Overused glassmorphism
- Generic stock-deck gradients
